evidence_text: Environment Agency official service-transition announcement: Esri image services were retired in favour of Open Standards. The announcement explicitly publishes a persistent WCS 2.0.1 GetCapabilities endpoint for LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model First Return DSM 2m. This is a distinct official no-login source window and is supplemental producer evidence only; parcel spatial binding, raster sampling/materialization and height-difference calculation remain local OpenCode responsibilities.
